title: ArtifactReference
description: Reference to an artifact produced for a work item (design revision, QA evidence, build artifact, decision). The artifact itself is stored by an opaque provider (uri).

artifactId.description: Unique identifier for this artifact reference

artifactType.description: Kind of artifact this reference points to

contentHash.description: Content hash of the artifact for integrity verification

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the reference was recorded
